awareness.subtitle: Explore essential agricultural guidance and modern farming methodologies to maximize yield and protect crops.
awareness.seeds_desc: Choose certified seeds to improve crop growth and reduce disease risk.
awareness.seed_selection_desc: Buy certified seeds from trusted dealers with tag labels verifying purity and high germination rates.
awareness.disease_resistance_desc: Prefer hybrid varieties that are specifically bred to resist localized leaf blights and soil-borne wilts.
awareness.seed_treatment_desc: Treat seeds with organic bio-fungicides (e.g. Trichoderma) before sowing to avoid seedling rot.
awareness.irrigation_desc: Provide the right amount of water to avoid root diseases.
awareness.drip_sprinklers_desc: Apply water directly to the plant root zone. This prevents overhead leaf wetness, cutting off fungal diseases.
awareness.morning_schedule_desc: Water crops early in the morning so the rising sun quickly evaporates excess surface water from the crop leaves.
awareness.stagnant_water_desc: Ensure drainage channels are clear. Standing stagnant water deprives roots of oxygen and induces rotting.
awareness.pesticides_organic_desc: Apply chemical or organic treatments properly and follow safety guidelines.
awareness.organic_remedies_desc: Prioritize natural alternatives like neem oil, garlic extract, compost teas, and biological controls to preserve helpful insects.
awareness.ipm_approach_desc: Intermix biological agents, organic soaps, and cultural methods before resorting to heavy synthetic chemicals.
awareness.precise_dosage_desc: Always dilute chemical inputs exactly per label recommendations. Excessive usage ruins plants and soil.
awareness.safe_app_desc: Always wear masks, gloves, and long sleeves when applying sprays, and avoid spraying during high wind currents.
awareness.weather_desc: Track weather conditions to protect crops from extreme climate.
awareness.forecast_alerts_desc: Follow regional agricultural forecasts. Keep track of rainy windows or high moisture that trigger blights.
awareness.canopy_mgmt_desc: Prune redundant lower leaves before heavy rainfall seasons to increase wind passage and keep fields aerated.
awareness.mulch_shields_desc: Add clean organic hay mulch to buffer soil temperatures and prevent moisture evaporation during heat waves.
awareness.soil_desc: Regularly test soil and maintain nutrient balance.
awareness.soil_tests_desc: Test your soil pH and N-P-K nutrient parameters before selecting fertilizer compositions every season.
awareness.organic_enrichment_desc: Incorporate organic compost, biochar, and well-composted manure to restore micro-biological diversity in the soil.
awareness.leguminous_rotations_desc: Rotate heavy-feeding grain crops with nitrogen-fixing cover crops (like peas, clover, and legumes).
awareness.modern_farming_desc: Use technology and AI tools for better agricultural productivity.
awareness.field_sensors_desc: Utilize simple hand-held electronic probes to check soil moisture percentages and direct irrigation plans.
awareness.ai_apps_desc: Submit pictures of leaf spots to AI tools like CropDiseaseAI at the very first sight of anomalies to get fast advisory.
awareness.precision_feeding_desc: Deliver trace minerals and nutrients in exact ratios rather than generic blanket chemical fertilizer casting.
about.about_desc: Bridging the gap between cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and local agricultural communities.
about.problem_desc: Crop leaf diseases present a severe threat to global food security and farming livelihoods. Traditional diagnostic methods depend heavily on agricultural experts, which is often slow, expensive, and unavailable in remote regions. Delayed diagnosis results in uncontrolled infection spread, crop loss, and high chemical remedy dependency, impacting smallholder farmers most.
